column1: # Ezhuthola's own Manglish chat words (GPL-3.0, part of Ezhuthola).
# Malayalam typed in English letters, the way people write it in chats.
# In English mode these are never "corrected" (machane stays machane, not machine)
# and they show as suggestions while typing. Common spellings of the same word are all listed.
# Counts: 15000 = everyday chat, 3000 = everything else. Both keep the word safe from autocorrect.
